name: Professional CRM Plugin
description: The people in a professional network, each touchpoint with them, the opportunities they bring and the brain's thoughts linked to them, in tables of the plugin's own: contacts searched word by word, interactions that move last_contacted on and never back, opportunities listed and moved on, follow-ups due, contacts going cold, a meeting briefing, and a thought linked through the brain as its caller. The learning path's Extension 5, ported from its standalone MCP server (SMD-2311).

contributors.name: Cesar Pinto
contributors.contribution: Original proposal (#93), crm_ prefix convention, FTS search, meeting prep tool, stale contact detection
